E0611

`use alias.item` but item is not defined

What

`use alias.item` but item is not defined

Why

An import member must name one item the module defines

Fix

Change `use alias.item` to import an item the aliased module defines.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0611: tests/ui/core_json_is_not_a_module.stderr.

Error [jet.UseUnknownItem]: `json` is not defined in module `core`
  --> tests/ui/core_json_is_not_a_module.jet:1:1
    |
  1 | use core.json
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: An import member must name one registered declaration
 Fix: Declare or import the member before selecting it
